turns.content: Estimate the Earth-frame travel time from the Large Magellanic Cloud over 1.6e5 light-years at constant speed 0.99999987c.
Calculate gamma=1/sqrt(1-beta^2) for beta=0.99999987, showing 1-beta^2. Use gamma approximately 1.96e3 in later steps.
Use the transformation factor established above to convert the coordinate travel time into the corresponding traveller-frame duration.
If the traveller departs at age 22, use the duration just obtained to determine the arrival age and compare it with the stated lifetime benchmark.
Report the traveller-frame duration to a precision warranted by the approximate distance and speed.
Assess the uncertainty introduced by the approximate distance and idealized constant-speed route.
Compare the Earth-frame and traveller-frame intervals, and identify which one determines the traveller's arrival age.
Report both travel times and the resulting arrival age, then assess compatibility with the stated lifetime while noting the route approximation.
